title: Electricity Consumption Monitor
statement: Monitor daily household electricity consumption in units for up to 30 days using a while loop. Requirements: If a reading is negative, print 'Invalid Reading' and skip it using continue; if > 500 units, print 'Unusually High Consumption'; if 0 is entered, stop reading using break; process at most 30 readings; display the count of valid readings and total consumption at the end.
hints: Carefully review the requirements in FAST_CL1002_F26_LAB10_P5.
Use standard C++ PF-lab constructs (nested loops, basic arrays, no banned STL).
